rush.title: Urgent or last-minute?
rush.body: I rarely take rush requests anymore. If it really can't wait, a rush session (max. 2 hours) costs [[spoedVoOnline]] online or [[spoedVoPhysical]] on location for secondary school, and [[spoedHboOnline]] online or [[spoedHboPhysical]] on location for higher education (university/HBO). Regular lessons: rate on request.
